function: Opening image; establishes cinematic atmosphere, vulnerability and professional scale.
relation: Opens from public space before the sequence moves toward water, body and enclosure.
alt: A figure in a white shirt sits on a rain-soaked riverside road beneath a grey sky.

function: First vertical pause and direct encounter after the wide hero.
relation: Carries the wet surface of the hero into a quieter, more elemental register.
alt: A nude figure stands waist-deep in a dark green river among submerged rocks.

function: Graphic interruption; turns identity into gesture and material.
relation: Replaces the previous direct gaze with concealment and angular movement.
alt: A seated figure in a purple shirt has their face hidden by long brown hair as their legs extend across a white bed.

function: Symbolic centre; joins anatomy and mineral form without illustration.
relation: The hidden face becomes a turned back; hair gives way to crystal.
alt: A bare back is framed by two arms holding a cluster of clear quartz crystals.

function: Horizontal release within the body-and-material passage.
relation: Extends the back motif while replacing hard crystal with soft fabric.
alt: A bare-backed figure gathers pale embroidered fabric against a muted grey background.

function: Close, tactile peak; makes the natural setting feel constructed and physical.
relation: Returns from controlled studio light to wet foliage and optical distortion.
alt: Close view of a face and hand partly submerged in water among wet green fern leaves.

function: Sharpens the sequence with hard daylight and a confronting gaze.
relation: Water becomes rock; reflective highlights become direct sunlight.
alt: Sunlit close portrait of a nude figure reclining against dark rocks and looking toward the camera.

function: Sculptural low point; removes the gaze and compresses the body into landscape.
relation: Completes a rock diptych by moving from contact to withdrawal.
alt: A nude figure folds into a sculptural pose on dark rock against a black background.

function: Cinematic scale change; opens the body sequence into narrative space.
relation: A small light answers the previous image's black field.
alt: A figure holds a small light above their head in a dark wooded landscape at night.

function: Longest visual breath and widest sense of scale.
relation: Expands the night passage from an intimate flame to a field of stars.
alt: A distant figure in red stands illuminated beneath a star-filled night sky.

function: Bright editorial reset before the closing image.
relation: Returns the sequence from nocturnal distance to an inhabited interior.
alt: A figure in a blue coat poses before a softly lit wall covered with a faded mural.

function: Closing portrait; concentrates the site's central elements into one saturated image.
relation: Returns to water and foliage with an open gaze, resolving the opening withdrawal.
alt: A figure in a red floral dress lies in dark water among wet green ferns and looks toward the camera.

function: Extends the Photography page with a clear editorial register.
relation: Connects the interior portrait to the night landscapes through foliage and directional light.
alt: A figure in a pale blue dress stands in profile against dense green leaves in low sunlight.

function: Adds professional portrait and constructed-environment evidence without weakening the homepage.
relation: Introduces an inhabited interior between sculptural bodies and exterior fashion.
alt: A dark-haired figure in a white shirt sits on a red chair in a dim room with dressmaker's mannequins.

function: Develops the concealed-identity motif as a quieter studio study.
relation: Pairs with IMG_1101 while avoiding repetition on the homepage.
alt: A red-haired nude figure sits folded on a tall stool against a black background, their face hidden by hair.

function: Creates a soft tonal pause within the extended body sequence.
relation: Moves from cool fabric to warm, diffuse skin before the darker hair study.
alt: Warm-toned soft-focus study of a seated nude body seen in profile.

function: Reserve for a future project page built around body-landscape equivalence.
relation: Conceptually strong but its embedded diptych language interrupts the V1 flow.
alt: Black-and-white diptych pairing a blurred reclining body with a distant mountain landscape.

function: Reserve for a coherent landscape corpus rather than the author-introduction sequence.
relation: Strong environmental evidence, but currently detached from the body's recurring role.
alt: A pale road curves through a rocky mountain landscape lined with wind-shaped trees.

function: Reserve companion for a future landscape project.
relation: Pairs naturally with IMG_1089, but the pair needs its own context and title.
alt: A green mountain valley and scattered buildings sit beneath a low, heavy sky.

function: Excluded from V1 because it reads as a conventional beauty portrait beside more authored images.
relation: Useful professional evidence, but visually redundant with stronger direct-gaze portraits.
alt: A close studio portrait of a face emerging from black, crossed by a narrow band of light.
